answer: Proposal: set weight and rewards by unspent coin-age -- stake times consecutive blocks held unmoved; transfer, delegation or lending resets the clock. The ledger never counts identities: a bridge of a thousand fresh clone keys holds zero weight until its coins age, and splitting aged coins across clones leaves summed weight unchanged. Minting a key costs a whisper and buys no influence; influence takes capital locked and still, costs forced to spiral with the influence sought. Limit: wealth buys weight; this prices sybils out of cheap amplification without detecting them.
